method: Read-only search followed by opening the cited publisher, licensed guide and walkthrough pages with the web tool.
scope: Three narrowly scoped location or prop checks; this is not verification of all 24 mechanism designs or any source animation.

checks.fact: The licensed Soulcalibur II guide associates its Windmill chapter with the Village of the Wind stage.
checks.locator: PDF page 5, printed page 147, Chapter 4-2; extracted lines 243-245 in the focused view
checks.adaptation: The code draws a wooden windmill and rotating sails. Their dimensions, sail geometry and period are authored and not validated against source frames. No clockwork claim is made for the Soulcalibur VI training corridor.

checks.fact: The official Tekken 4 airport description identifies aircraft parked on the apron, including their wheels as features of the original stage.
checks.sourceType: publisher stage page, opened and read
checks.adaptation: The background aircraft and wheels stay fixed. The small rotating fan is a mechanical interpretation of the engine; the page does not certify an original engine animation loop. Original stage collisions are not reproduced or added.

checks.fact: The Devil May Cry 3 walkthrough describes rotating gears in Gears of Madness during mission 15.
checks.locator: Mission 15, Gears of Madness; extracted lines 994-1002
checks.adaptation: Three back-wall gears rotate as decorative geometry. Their original contact damage, switches, platforms and tower progression are not simulated.

contextSearchOnly.scope: Indexed excerpts identify Zepp as an airship setting and May Ship as the Jellyfish Pirates' airship. Full-page opens returned 403 and are not recorded as successful reads.
contextSearchOnly.adaptation: Propeller housings, the anchor winch and their cycles remain openly authored mechanical interpretations of those settings.
